description_en: Specifies the commands that can or cannot be run by the users or on the assets associated with the policy and the commands that must be reviewed
description_zh: 配置在指定策略生效用户和主机中，允许或禁止执行的命令，以及需要审批的命令
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-command-config --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1ghxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 45 --command-config '{"Deny":{},"Approval":{}}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPolicyCommandConfig

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the control policy that you want to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html operation to query the control policy ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要修改的控制策略ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

fields.help_en: The commands that can be run only after approval
fields.name: commands

fields.help_en:
The command approval settings.

A command approval policy is used to approve the commands that are excluded from a whitelist or blacklist specified in a command control policy. The command control policy takes precedence over the command approval policy in validation
fields.help_zh:
命令审批配置。

命令审批对命令控制（白名单或黑名单）以外的命令生效。命令控制策略生效的优先级高于命令审批
fields.name: approval

fields.help_en:
The type of command control. Valid values:

black: blacklist mode.

white: whitelist mode
fields.help_zh:
命令控制类型。取值：

black：黑名单模式
white：白名单模式
fields.name: acl_type

fields.help_en:
The commands to be controlled.

This parameter is required if AclType is set to white
fields.help_zh:
命令列表。

AclType 设置为 white 时，Commands 为必填
fields.name: commands

parameters.help_en:
The command control settings.

This parameter applies only to Linux hosts
parameters.help_zh:
命令控制配置。

仅适用于Linux主机
parameters.name: command_config
